crossRefs.note: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house…
Therefore I will give him a portion with the great. He will divide the plunder with the strong; because he poured out…
For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are…

translations.web: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.
translations.bsb: And now my soul is poured out within me; days of affliction grip me.
translations.kjv: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold
translations.asv: And now my soul is poured out within me; Days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
